knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic account evidence
knowledge.detail: Fixed account, stakeholder, activity, news, competitor, adoption, and risk records support deterministic demonstrations.

knowledge.name: Operating rules and evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Uploaded rules define calculations, routing, required headings, synthetic labels, and prohibited actions for all six operations.

intelligence_processing.name: Account evidence consolidation
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines firmographic, adoption, engagement, support, and recent-activity evidence into a unified account overview.

intelligence_processing.name: Stakeholder and relationship analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps buying roles, influence, sentiment, engagement, champions, and relationship gaps from the fixed evidence snapshot.

intelligence_processing.name: Competitive positioning analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic competitor activity, relationship depth, product fit, pricing, implementation, advantages, and threats.

intelligence_processing.name: Deal risk and mitigation analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains synthetic deal risks, severity, candidate mitigations, and a computed win-probability indicator without forecast writes.

intelligence_processing.name: Messaging and briefing preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts persona-aligned talking points, objection handling, executive summaries, and pre-meeting checklists for human review.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access for account executives, sales directors, and customer-success managers in a Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP agent through the local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with synthetic-only routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first review outputs
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents synthetic snapshot, cited evidence, analysis, draft preparation, and an explicit approval gate in reviewable responses.

management_reporting.name: Account health and activity overview
management_reporting.detail: Reports account attributes, health score, engagement, adoption, support sentiment, renewal risk, and recent synthetic activity.

management_reporting.name: Deal risk and competitive review
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes competitor signals, positioning considerations, deal risks, mitigation options, and synthetic planning indicators.

management_reporting.name: Executive pre-meeting briefing
management_reporting.detail: Compiles opportunity, account health, stakeholder, competition, risk, and checklist views for meeting and account planning.

tools.name: Portable RAPP Account Intelligence Agent
tools.detail: Single-file AccountIntelligenceAgent implements six read-only operations with bundled synthetic data and no credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the natural-language agent package; the validated solution remains Draft and requires explicit approval before publish.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
tools.detail: Approved production seam for account and relationship context; it is not connected in the current synthetic package.

tools.name: SharePoint
tools.detail: Approved production seam for account plans and references; the current package instead uses bundled synthetic knowledge files.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Approved collaboration and meeting-preparation seam; no message, meeting, task, or customer action is configured.

tools.name: Approved business-intelligence source
tools.detail: Dedicated approved connection reference may replace synthetic evidence only after review; none is configured in the package.

tools.name: Foundation model selected by deployment environment
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used for conversational routing and response generation.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled allow-listed evidence and forbids browsing, enrichment, substitution, or invention of missing facts.

supporting_features.name: Six deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes account overview, stakeholder map, competitive intel, value messaging, risk assessment, and executive briefing requests.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-first response contract
supporting_features.detail: Separates recorded evidence from computed indicators and labels exact names, values, scores, and projections as synthetic.

supporting_features.name: Human approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Requires authorized account-owner and relevant legal, privacy, sales, customer-success, and commercial review before external use.

supporting_features.name: Read-only governance boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prevents CRM writes, outreach, tasks, meetings, alerts, proposals, pricing approvals, forecast changes, and customer communication.

supporting_features.name: Locked demo and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Maintains one persona-language case per operation and records six passing captures with only AccountIntelligenceAgent loaded.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Keeps Copilot Studio artifacts in Draft, validates before push, and makes publication a separate user-approved step.
